params.name: Sid
params.description: The SID of the Event resource to fetch.

params.name: ActorSid
params.description: Only include events initiated by this Actor. Useful for auditing actions taken by specific users or API credentials.

params.name: ResourceSid
params.description: Only include events that refer to this resource. Useful for discovering the history of a specific resource.

params.name: SourceIpAddress
params.description: Only include events that originated from this IP address. Useful for tracking suspicious activity originating from the API or the Twilio Console.

params.name: StartDate
params.description: Only include events that occurred on or after this date. Specify the date in GMT and [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

params.name: EndDate
params.description: Only include events that occurred on or before this date. Specify the date in GMT and [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

params.name: PageSize
params.description: How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.

params.name: Page
params.description: The page index. This value is simply for client state.

params.name: PageToken
params.description: The page token. This is provided by the API.

items.docs: Returns a list of events in the account, sorted by event-date.
